standard.summary: 额外训练带可学习参数的归一化层（如 RMSNorm/LayerNorm 的缩放与偏置）。
standard.whenToUse: 不确定时先保持默认，小步数短测后再调。
standard.avoidWhen: 与预检冲突或与其它互斥选项同时开启时。

standard_en.summary: Additionally trains normalisation layers that carry learnable parameters (the scale and bias of RMSNorm/LayerNorm, say).
standard_en.whenToUse: When unsure keep the default; run a short low-step test before changing it.
standard_en.avoidWhen: When it conflicts with preflight, or when a mutually exclusive option is enabled at the same time.

advanced.principle: 额外训练带可学习参数的归一化层（如 RMSNorm/LayerNorm 的 weight/bias），让 LoRA/lulynx 渐进秩 LoRA/LoKr 之外还能调整特征尺度与分布；可能提升风格/域适配，但会小幅增加显存占用和 LoRA 文件大小，也更容易过拟合，默认建议关闭。

advanced_en.principle: Additionally trains normalization layers with learnable parameters (e.g. RMSNorm/LayerNorm weight/bias), letting LoRA / lulynx progressive-rank LoRA / LoKr also adjust feature scale and distribution; may improve style/domain adaptation, but slightly increases VRAM usage and LoRA file size and is more prone to overfitting — recommended off by default.
